messages:
Ilana Patel: Quick heads-up — Cypress Telecom just escalated to their CTO. Main blockers: BYO-KMS for Private, legal wants SAML/SCIM details, and pricing runway for a 6-month dedicated pool. They want answers by EOD tomorrow. Can we triage?
Mike Chen: Noted. BYO-KMS is supported in Private but requires a short ops playbook. I can paste the minimal steps. Does Cypress want HSM or just KMS key import?
Ilana Patel: CTO said they need external KMS with HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2). Also asking if we can do per-tenant encryption key rotation.
Sarah Gomez: We support BYO-KMS + rotation. Ops need the IAM service account and the key ARN. I'll pull the exact config snippet and send.
Raj Kapoor: For Private we'll need to validate their network egress rules for the KMS endpoint and run a handshake with their KMS admin. ETA for validation: 24–36h once we have contact + test creds.
Taylor Nguyen: Pricing question — sales asked whether a 6-month Dedicated commit can be prorated mid-quarter and if we can provide an introductory discount tied to volume. Legal also wants the pricing appendix for review. @Ilana can you confirm target ARR and expected qps?
Ilana Patel: They're targeting ~$450k ARR in year 1, and initial qps profile is 120rps peak (chat gen). Can we propose a 15% commit discount with a clause for scale-based uplift?
Eleni Rodriguez: I'll own the SQA + legal questionnaire. Please send the completed security matrix by noon — I'll fold into the NC/contract packet.
Mike Chen: Config snippet for YAML-based Private deploy (minimal):
```
redwood_private:
  kms:
    provider: aws_kms
    key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE
    hsm_required: true
  key_rotation: daily
```
This is the template — we'll need their actual ARN and a service principal for access.
Ilana Patel: @Raj can you confirm if the handshake needs port 443 only or other ports for key exchange? Also can we offer a temporary hosted-staging with cached keys while private is validated? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj Kapoor: Only 443 to KMS endpoints. For the staged workaround we can use a cached prefix + short-lived replica keys, but that requires Product sign-off — it changes the threat model a bit. I can draft the risk note.
Sarah Gomez: Product is OK with a time-boxed fallback (30 days) for staging as long as we document it and get a signed exception. I'll coordinate.
Taylor Nguyen: I'll model two pricing options and share a short table by EOD: (1) 6-month commit with 15% discount, (2) 3-month pilot then commit with smaller discount + onboarding fee. Which would you prefer for exec?
Ilana Patel: Exec prefers option 1 if legal/ops sign-off is fast. Otherwise option 2. Need the security matrix and pricing table for the exec call at 10am PT tomorrow.
deploy-bot: A calendar probe was sent to Cypress-CTO for 10:00 AM PT tomorrow. (If that time fails, please propose 11:30.)
Eleni Rodriguez: Ilana — I'll take the security matrix, Raj pls DM me test endpoints/ports. Mike pls drop the documented playbook link.
Mike Chen: Link: https://intranet.redwood.dev/private-deploy/kms-playbook — will upload an abbreviated checklist to this thread in 30m.
Raj Kapoor: DM sent to Eleni with network checks + sample tcpdump commands.
Ilana Patel: Thanks all. Action items recap: 1) Mike — abbreviated playbook + checklist (30m). 2) Raj — network validation + risk note (24h). 3) Eleni — compile security matrix + legal packet (by noon tomorrow). 4) Taylor — pricing options + table (EOD today). 5) Sarah — get Product exception wording for 30-day staged fallback. Exec call 10am PT tomorrow. Ping me if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
Mike Chen: Acknowledged.
Sarah Gomez: On it.
Taylor Nguyen: Will route pricing through RevOps and share numbers in the thread.
Eleni Rodriguez: Got it — will have draft legal packet for review at 9am PT tomorrow.
Ilana Patel: If we can get the checklist + matrix tonight I can draft the exec slide and CTO summary. Appreciate the quick turnaround team.
Mike Chen: Uploading checklist now...
(END)
